instruction: A rocking chair hand-carved from a single tone of warm walnut, its curved runners, spindled back, and scrolled armrests flowing with visible chisel facets and wood grain. Ornate leaf motifs are relief-carved into the crest rail, and the timber surface glows with a hand-rubbed satin finish.
